description: M3-28 confirmatory test v2 of the Paper 1 frozen configuration (paper1-v4-frozen-config) on participant T12 (Willett et al. 2023, B2T '24 competitionData, CC0). Stronger own decoder; pre-registration: preregistration.md (commit: see preregistration_commit).
archive_source: https://zenodo.org/records/8047896 (Zenodo deposit of Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.x69p8czpq), CC0 1.0

decoder.smooth: causal half-Gaussian (past bins only, so latency 0)

word_route: B2T '25 config unchanged: experiments/2026-11-10-b2t25-trust/config.json + tuned lm_weight 1.0, edit_penalty 12, word_bonus 3

normalisation.order: train blocks in file order, then the test block; per session
normalisation.first_trials: the first window_trials trials of a session use the stats of those same trials (decoder-train data only)

word_lm.model: interpolated Kneser-Ney word trigram, D 0.75, Tatoeba English (CC BY 2.0 FR), wordlm.py
word_lm.choice: best sentence exact on decoder validation over the grid (results/lm-tune.json); 2.0 is the grid edge
